name: Ureta Karada wa Boku Sen'you ~Motomeau Sado Masochism~
original_name: 熟れたカラダは僕専用 ～求め合うサドマゾヒズム～
source:
Namino Yuuta enrolls into a school under his mother recommendation.
This school used to be an prestigious all-girls school, but because of the declining number of students, it had no choice but to go coed.

Yuuta thought there would be a few male students here and there but to his surprise, he is the only male in the whole school.
Not only that but the boy's dorm is all the way up a mountain behind the school. Yuuta a very shy kid feels uneasy and depressed about the future.

At least Yuuta's aunt, Risako whom he's loved since he was a little kid, works at the boy's dorm as the dorm mother and caretaker.
One day, Yuuta arrives at the dorm earlier than usual, and finds Risako bound in a S&M rope play.

"Yuu-chan, stop, don't rape me"- Risako says, fantasizing.
After hearing that, Yuuta can't control his feelings anymore.
translation:
波野佑太在母亲的推荐下入读学校。
这所学校原本是一所享有盛誉的女子学校，但由于学生人数不断减少，不得不改为男女混校。

裕太以为会有几个男学生，但令他惊讶的是，他是整个学校唯一的男生。
不仅如此，男生宿舍就在学校后面的一座山上。裕太是一个非常害羞的孩子，对未来感到不安和沮丧。

至少，悠太从小就深爱着的姨妈莉沙子，在男生宿舍里担任舍监兼管理员。
有一天，佑太比平时更早到达宿舍，发现里沙子正在玩S&M绳索游戏。

“小优，停下来，别强奸我”——里沙子一边幻想一边说道。
听到这句话，佑太再也无法控制自己的情绪了。
